paper_title: Constraining Light QCD Axions with Isolated Neutron Star Cooling
notes: Light-QCD-axion constraint from anomalous fast cooling of isolated neutron stars (does NOT require the axion to be dark matter, so no density rescaling; dm_density null). Headline result is Fig.5, the bright-red 'Neutron stars (this work)' band in the (m_a [eV], 1/f_a [GeV^-1]) plane. Extracted as figure_vector from the e-print file Axion_fa_NS_Cooling.pdf: the pure-red fill (RGB 1,0,0), drawing index 33 (outer edge), which is bounded by the SOLID line = conservative limit (g+g_a)_14>100 (the paper's stated conservative/headline choice); the lighter pink extension bounded by the dashed (g+g_a)_14>50 line is NOT included. Axis calibration from major tick marks: x major decades 160.93 pt (10^-20 eV) to 1081.63 pt (10^1 eV), 43.843 pt/decade; y major decades 53.04 pt (10^-4) to 662.88 pt (10^-20), 38.115 pt/decade. The reported points form the CLOSED contour of the excluded band (not monotonic in mass): starting at the top-right frame corner, down the right frame edge, along the upper-left (conservative) boundary line down to the rounded low-mass cap near m_a~2.2e-9 eV, around the cap, then up the lower-right boundary (runs just above the yellow QCD-axion line) which exits the top frame edge near m_a~0.35 eV. Band is cut off by the plot frame at high mass (m_a up to 10 eV, 1/f_a up to 10^-4). No statistical confidence level is quoted; the exclusion is an astrophysical cooling argument (conservative criterion), so confidence_level is null. BSk26 EOS; epsilon<~0.1 sources a new ground state (NGS).
